name: nl.winkelstraat/catalog
title: Winkelstraat.nl item catalog
description: Search the Winkelstraat.nl designer fashion catalog: items, prices, sizes in stock, designers.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the winkelstraat.nl catalog. Combine a free-text query with a category id and/or a designer slug. Returns name, designer, price in EUR, sizes in stock and the item URL.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "zwarte sneakers" or "moncler jas".

category_id.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "MTM=" for Dames.

designer.description: A designer slug from list_designers, e.g. "moncler".

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories with the ids search_items takes. With `query`: categories whose name matches, with their full path (e.g. "Dames > Schoenen > Sneakers"). With `parent_id`: that category's subcategories. With neither: the top level (Dames, Heren, Kinderen) and their direct subcategories.

query.description: Part of a category name, e.g. "sneakers" or "jurken".

parent_id.description: A category id; returns its subcategories.

tools.name: list_designers
tools.description: Designer brands the store carries, with the slug search_items and get_designer take. Pass `query` (part of the name) to find one; without it you get the first `limit` brands A-Z and the total.

query.description: Part of a designer name, e.g. "mon" or "stone island".

tools.name: get_designer
tools.description: One designer brand: name, description and the URL of its page on winkelstraat.nl.
